title: TinyViT-5M at 90 MHz — FPGA and HPS operation map
status: 40 static-weight GEMMs; 454 FPGA jobs per image
description: Capacity-aware driver tiles each job for 32 KiB activation, 64 KiB weight, and 64 KiB output banks. Full K stays within each job for this model; compute tails are padded to 16 lanes for the 16×16 array. Traversal reuses a resident operand and transfers only live rows where supported. Eight MLP pairs in layers.1 and layers.2 run FC1 → inline GELU LUT → local FPGA feedback → FC2 with the hidden INT8 tensor resident in FPGA RAM.
